note: Prototype cases. kind: positive = must load the expected skills; negative = must not load the forbidden ones; confusable = a neighbouring skill looks applicable but is not. Skills not listed in expect, forbid or allow are reported as extras. The top-level allow list and allow_by_tag (per case tags) are added to each case's allow list.
